title: Samurai Champloo
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A two-volume manga based on the anime of the same name, set in an Edo-period Japan mixed with deliberate hip-hop anachronisms. Mugen, a rough mercenary, and Jin, a disciplined samurai, travel with Fuu, a resourceful young waitress, on her quest to find a mysterious samurai, brawling with nobles and underworld figures along the way (TOKYOPOP blurb via AniList; MU).
life_message: Loyalty grows between unlikely companions who choose to keep traveling together.

content.note: Sword fights, throwing stars and 'a lethal dose of street justice' (TOKYOPOP blurb); Samurai, Swordplay, Assassins tags (AniList, MU).
